34	class _Column(_ClientList):
35	    # shortcuts for current client and index used in Columns layout
36	    cw = _ClientList.current_client
37	    current = _ClientList.current_index
38	
39	    def __init__(self, split, insert_position, width=100):
40	        _ClientList.__init__(self)
41	        self.width = width
42	        self.split = split
43	        self.insert_position = insert_position
44	        self.heights = {}
45	
46	    @expose_command()
47	    def info(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
48	        info = _ClientList.info(self)
49	        info.update(
50	            dict(
51	                heights=[self.heights[c] for c in self.clients],
52	                split=self.split,
53	            )
54	        )
55	        return info
56	
57	    def toggle_split(self):
58	        self.split = not self.split
59	
60	    def add_client(self, client, height=100):
61	        _ClientList.add_client(self, client, self.insert_position)
62	        self.heights[client] = height
63	        delta = 100 - height
64	        if delta != 0:
65	            n = len(self)
66	            growth = [int(delta / n)] * n
67	            growth[0] += delta - sum(growth)
68	            for c, g in zip(self, growth):
69	                self.heights[c] += g
70	
71	    def remove(self, client: Window) -> None:
72	        _ClientList.remove(self, client)
73	        delta = self.heights[client] - 100
74	        del self.heights[client]
75	        if delta != 0:
76	            n = len(self)
77	            growth = [int(delta / n)] * n
78	            growth[0] += delta - sum(growth)
79	            for c, g in zip(self, growth):
80	                self.heights[c] += g
81	
82	    def __str__(self):
83	        cur = self.current
84	        return "_Column: " + ", ".join(
85	            [
86	                "[%s: %d]" % (c.name, self.heights[c])
87	                if c == cur
88	                else "%s: %d" % (c.name, self.heights[c])
89	                for c in self.clients
90	            ]

94	class Columns(Layout):
95	    """Extension of the Stack layout.
96	
97	    The screen is split into columns, which can be dynamically added or
98	    removed.  Each column can present its windows in 2 modes: split or
99	    stacked.  In split mode, all windows are presented simultaneously,
100	    spliting the column space.  In stacked mode, only a single window is
101	    presented from the stack of windows.  Columns and windows can be
102	    resized and windows can be shuffled around.
103	
104	    This layout can also emulate wmii's default layout via:
105	
106	        layout.Columns(num_columns=1, insert_position=1)
107	
108	    Or the "Vertical", and "Max", depending on the default parameters.
109	
110	    An example key configuration is::
111	
112	        Key([mod], "j", lazy.layout.down()),
113	        Key([mod], "k", lazy.layout.up()),
114	        Key([mod], "h", lazy.layout.left()),
115	        Key([mod], "l", lazy.layout.right()),
116	        Key([mod, "shift"], "j", lazy.layout.shuffle_down()),
117	        Key([mod, "shift"], "k", lazy.layout.shuffle_up()),
118	        Key([mod, "shift"], "h", lazy.layout.shuffle_left()),
119	        Key([mod, "shift"], "l", lazy.layout.shuffle_right()),
120	        Key([mod, "control"], "j", lazy.layout.grow_down()),
121	        Key([mod, "control"], "k", lazy.layout.grow_up()),
122	        Key([mod, "control"], "h", lazy.layout.grow_left()),
123	        Key([mod, "control"], "l", lazy.layout.grow_right()),
124	        Key([mod, "shift", "control"], "h", lazy.layout.swap_column_left()),
125	        Key([mod, "shift", "control"], "l", lazy.layout.swap_column_right()),
126	        Key([mod], "Return", lazy.layout.toggle_split()),
127	        Key([mod], "n", lazy.layout.normalize()),
128	    """
129	
130	    _left = 0
131	    _right = 1
132	
133	    defaults = [
134	        ("border_focus", "#881111", "Border colour(s) for the focused window."),
135	        ("border_normal", "#220000", "Border colour(s) for un-focused windows."),
136	        (
137	            "border_focus_stack",
138	            "#881111",
139	            "Border colour(s) for the focused window in stacked columns.",
140	        ),
141	        (
142	            "border_normal_stack",
143	            "#220000",
144	            "Border colour(s) for un-focused windows in stacked columns.",
145	        ),
146	        ("border_width", 2, "Border width."),
147	        ("single_border_width", None, "Border width for single window."),
148	        ("border_on_single", False, "Draw a border when there is one only window."),
149	        ("margin", 0, "Margin of the layout (int or list of ints [N E S W])."),
150	        (
151	            "margin_on_single",
152	            None,
153	            "Margin when only one window. (int or list of ints [N E S W])",
154	        ),
155	        ("split", True, "New columns presentation mode."),
156	        ("num_columns", 2, "Preferred number of columns."),
157	        ("grow_amount", 10, "Amount by which to grow a window/column."),
158	        ("fair", False, "Add new windows to the column with least windows."),
159	        (
160	            "insert_position",
161	            0,
162	            "Position relative to the current window where new ones are inserted "
163	            "(0 means right above the current window, 1 means right after).",
164	        ),
165	        ("wrap_focus_columns", True, "Wrap the screen when moving focus across columns."),
166	        ("wrap_focus_rows", True, "Wrap the screen when moving focus across rows."),
167	        ("wrap_focus_stacks", True, "Wrap the screen when moving focus across stacked."),
168	        (
169	            "align",
170	            _right,
171	            "Which side of screen new windows will be added to "
172	            "(one of ``Columns._left`` or ``Columns._right``). "
173	            "Ignored if 'fair=True'.",
174	        ),
175	        ("initial_ratio", 1, "Ratio of first column to second column."),
176	    ]
177	
178	    def __init__(self, **config):
179	        Layout.__init__(self, **config)
180	        self.add_defaults(Columns.defaults)
181	        if not self.border_on_single:
182	            self.single_border_width = 0
183	        elif self.single_border_width is None:
184	            self.single_border_width = self.border_width
185	
186	        if self.margin_on_single is None:
187	            self.margin_on_single = self.margin
188	        self.columns = [_Column(self.split, self.insert_position)]
189	        self.current = 0
190	        if self.align not in (Columns._left, Columns._right):
191	            logger.warning(
192	                "Unexpected value for `align`. Must be Columns._left or Columns._right."
193	            )
194	            self.align = Columns._right
195	
196	    def clone(self, group: _Group) -> Self:
197	        c = Layout.clone(self, group)
198	        c.columns = [_Column(self.split, self.insert_position)]
199	        return c
200	
201	    def get_windows(self):
202	        clients = []
203	        for c in self.columns:
204	            clients.extend(c.clients)
205	        return clients
206	
207	    @expose_command()
208	    def info(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
209	        d = Layout.info(self)
210	        d["clients"] = []
211	        d["columns"] = []
212	        for c in self.columns:
213	            cinfo = c.info()
214	            d["clients"].extend(cinfo["clients"])
215	            d["columns"].append(cinfo)
216	        d["current"] = self.current
217	        return d
218	
219	    def focus(self, client: Window) -> None:
220	        for i, c in enumerate(self.columns):
221	            if client in c:
222	                c.focus(client)
223	                self.current = i
224	                break
225	
226	    @property
227	    def cc(self):
228	        return self.columns[self.current]
229	
230	    def get_ratio_widths(self):
231	        # Total width is 200
232	        # main + secondary = 200
233	        # main = secondary * ratio
234	        # secondary column is therefore 200 / (1 + ratio)
235	        # main column is 200 - secondary column
236	        secondary = 200 // (1 + self.initial_ratio)
237	        main = 200 - secondary
238	        return main, secondary
239	
240	    def add_column(self, prepend=False):
241	        c = _Column(self.split, self.insert_position)
242	        if prepend:
243	            self.columns.insert(0, c)
244	            self.current += 1
245	        else:
246	            self.columns.append(c)
247	        if len(self.columns) == 2 and not self.fair:
248	            main, secondary = self.get_ratio_widths()
249	            self.cc.width = main
250	            c.width = secondary
251	        return c
252	
253	    def remove_column(self, col):
254	        if len(self.columns) == 1:
255	            logger.warning("Trying to remove all columns.")
256	            return
257	        idx = self.columns.index(col)
258	        del self.columns[idx]
259	        if idx <= self.current:
260	            self.current = max(0, self.current - 1)
261	        delta = col.width - 100
262	        if delta != 0:
263	            n = len(self.columns)
264	            growth = [int(delta / n)] * n
265	            growth[0] += delta - sum(growth)
266	            for c, g in zip(self.columns, growth):
267	                c.width += g
268	
269	    def add_client(self, client: Window) -> None:
270	        c = self.cc
271	        if len(c) > 0 and len(self.columns) < self.num_columns:
272	            prepend = self.align is Columns._left
273	            c = self.add_column(prepend=prepend)
274	        if self.fair:
275	            least = min(self.columns, key=len)
276	            if len(least) < len(c):
277	                c = least
278	        self.current = self.columns.index(c)
279	        c.add_client(client)
280	
281	    def remove(self, client):
282	        remove = None
283	        for c in self.columns:
284	            if client in c:
285	                c.remove(client)
286	                if len(c) == 0 and len(self.columns) > 1:
287	                    remove = c
288	                break
289	        if remove is not None:
290	            self.remove_column(c)
291	        return self.columns[self.current].cw
292	
293	    def configure(self, client: Window, screen_rect: ScreenRect) -> None:
294	        pos = 0
295	        for col in self.columns:
296	            if client in col:
297	                break
298	            pos += col.width
299	        else:
300	            client.hide()
301	            return
302	
303	        if client.has_focus:
304	            color = self.border_focus if col.split else self.border_focus_stack
305	        else:
306	            color = self.border_normal if col.split else self.border_normal_stack
307	
308	        is_single = len(self.columns) == 1 and (len(col) == 1 or not col.split)
309	        border = self.single_border_width if is_single else self.border_width
310	        margin_size = self.margin_on_single if is_single else self.margin
311	
312	        width = int(0.5 + col.width * screen_rect.width * 0.01 / len(self.columns))
313	        x = screen_rect.x + int(0.5 + pos * screen_rect.width * 0.01 / len(self.columns))
314	
315	        if col.split:
316	            pos = 0
317	            for c in col:
318	                if client == c:
319	                    break
320	                pos += col.heights[c]
321	            height = int(0.5 + col.heights[client] * screen_rect.height * 0.01 / len(col))
322	            y = screen_rect.y + int(0.5 + pos * screen_rect.height * 0.01 / len(col))
323	            client.place(
324	                x, y, width - 2 * border, height - 2 * border, border, color, margin=margin_size
325	            )
326	            client.unhide()
327	        elif client == col.cw:
328	            client.place(
329	                x,
330	                screen_rect.y,
331	                width - 2 * border,
332	                screen_rect.height - 2 * border,
333	                border,
334	                color,
335	                margin=margin_size,
336	            )
337	            client.unhide()
338	        else:
339	            client.hide()
340	
341	    def focus_first(self) -> Window | None:
342	        """Returns first client in first column of layout"""
343	        if self.columns:
344	            return self.columns[0].focus_first()
345	        return None
346	
347	    def focus_last(self) -> Window | None:
348	        """Returns last client in last column of layout"""
349	        if self.columns:
350	            return self.columns[-1].focus_last()
351	        return None
352	
353	    def focus_next(self, win: Window) -> None:
354	        """Returns the next client after 'win' in layout,
355	        or None if there is no such client"""
356	        # First: try to get next window in column of win (self.columns is non-empty)
357	        # pylint: disable=undefined-loop-variable
358	        for idx, col in enumerate(self.columns):

362	                break

364	        if idx + 1 < len(self.columns):
365	            return self.columns[idx + 1].focus_first()
366	        return None
367	
368	    def focus_previous(self, win: Window) -> Window | None:
369	        """Returns the client previous to 'win' in layout.
370	        or None if there is no such client"""
371	        # First: try to focus previous client in column (self.columns is non-empty)
372	        # pylint: disable=undefined-loop-variable
373	        for idx, col in enumerate(self.columns):
374	            if win in col:
375	                if prev := col.focus_previous(win):
376	                    return prev
377	                break
378	        # If there was no previous, get last from previous column
379	        if idx > 0:
380	            return self.columns[idx - 1].focus_last()
381	        return None

from types import SimpleNamespace

from libqtile.layout.columns import Columns


class DummyWin:
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        self.name = name

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"DummyWin({self.name})"


class TestColumnsIndirectAddClientInputStateQA:
    def test_columns_indirect_add_client_input_state_case(self):
        layout = Columns(
            num_columns=3,
            insert_position=1,
            grow_amount=13,
            split=True,
            initial_ratio=1.7,
        )
        layout._group = SimpleNamespace(
            layout_all=lambda: None,
            focus=lambda *_args, **_kwargs: None,
        )

        windows = [DummyWin(f"w{i}") for i in range(1, 9)]
        for win in windows:
            layout.add_client(win)

        # Non-trivial state mutations before the final indirect call chain.
        layout.current = 2
        layout.cc.current_index = 1
        layout.grow_up()
        layout.grow_up()
        layout.grow_down()
        layout.shuffle_up()
        layout.grow_down()

        # Indirect target chain: shuffle_right -> add_column -> _Column.add_client.
        layout.shuffle_right()

        assert len(layout.columns) == 4
        assert [w.name for w in layout.columns[-1].clients] == ["w4"]
